title: Sources & further reading
body:
Facts in this guide were checked directly against operator and official sources where possible: Hinomaru Bus and Hinomaru Hire (the Kurayoshi–Misasa transfer, bus and jumbo taxi), Misasakan ryokan (the reserved-shuttle alternative), JR Odekake Net (Kurayoshi Station accessibility), Misasa Onsen's official portal, Sanbutsu-ji/Mitokusan, Misasa Town, Tottori Prefecture's official tourism site, Tottori City's tourism site, Kurayoshi tourism, the Sand Museum, San'in Matsushima Yuran, Yakiniku Masashige, Marutsu (crab-season regulatory data), and JNTO for entry rules and emergency information. Crowd-timing and party-size-feasibility notes on the Sand Dunes and Menya Hachibee rest on independently corroborated firsthand accounts (banzokubiology.com, note.com/nambuline_love, na-na.media, umazeriko.hatenablog.com), each cross-checked against a second independent source before shipping.

A few facts remain flagged rather than confirmed: the Kurayoshi–Misasa public bus's exact fare (the operator's own fare table is a PDF that couldn't be read), Menya Hachibee's hours (no qualifying primary source located), and Japan's current US travel-advisory level (travel.state.gov blocked plain fetches here). These are called out inline where they appear.
